Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check: is story 4 done, is task 15 done, and is story 3 done now that the idempotency keys are in?
Please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your update and that you have no blockers.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock you on getting the idempotency keys in so you can pick the summary page back up?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, were story 5 and bug 12 done from your earlier commitments?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Who can help unblock bug 12, where the sandbox gateway keeps timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: Pair with him on staging access today.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
That's everything from me.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, about task 14—you said you should finish it tomorrow; is it done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
Mail blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, since the sandbox was down and you’re aiming to finish it tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised include the sandbox being down, the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway for bug 12, and the PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review. The summary page work is on track and will be picked back up once idempotency keys are in, and there were no topics parked, nobody absent, and nobody in the meeting who didn’t respond. Items not covered were task 19 and task 15, and their owners will get a follow-up. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams, and thank you everyone.
